# Top 10 Best Robot Vacuums Under $300 in 2026

Robot vacuums have come a long way from the buggy discs of the early 2010s. Today models navigate with LiDAR, map your home, and even empty their own dustbins. We tested 18 robot vacuums under $300 and found several that compete with models twice the price.

## Our Top Picks in Detail

### 1. Roborock Qrevo - Best Overall Under $300

The Roborock Qrevo is the undisputed king of budget robot vacuums. Its LiDAR navigation creates precise maps of your home, and the 5500 Pa suction power handles everything from fine dust to pet hair with ease. The 150-minute battery life covers homes up to 2,500 square feet. The auto-empty dock holds up to 7 weeks of debris. At $279.99, it delivers premium features at a mid-range price.

**Price:** $279.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 2. Eufy RoboVac X8 - Best Value

At $249.99, the Eufy RoboVac X8 offers LiDAR navigation and 4000 Pa suction - specs that rival vacuums costing $100 more. The TwinJet dual brushes provide thorough cleaning. The 120-minute battery covers most apartments. The companion app supports multi-floor mapping.

**Price:** $249.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 3. Shark IQ Robot - Best for Pet Hair

Shark has been a leader in pet hair removal. Its self-emptying base holds a full week of dirt and debris, and the self-cleaning brushroll prevents hair tangles. At $199.99, it is one of the most affordable self-emptying options available.

**Price:** $199.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 4. iRobot Roomba 694 - Most Reliable Brand

iRobot invented the robot vacuum category. While it uses random navigation instead of LiDAR, the software is refined and reliable. It rarely gets stuck and always finds its way back to the charging dock. At $274.99, the iRobot ecosystem and app reliability make it a solid choice.

**Price:** $274.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 5. Cheermo T30Pro - Best Budget Pick

The Cheermo T30Pro at just $159.99 is the most affordable option that still delivers respectable performance. The gyroscopic navigation covers most floors efficiently. Ideal for apartments and smaller homes.

**Price:** $159.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

## How We Chose These Robot Vacuums

We tested each robot vacuum over 2-4 weeks:

- **Navigation efficiency:** Time to clean a standard 800 sq ft apartment
- **Suction power:** Measured on hard floors and carpets
- **Obstacle avoidance:** Tested with common household items
- **Battery life:** Actual runtime until auto-return
- **App functionality:** Map accuracy and scheduling

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Do robot vacuums work on carpets?**
A: Most work on low to medium-pile carpets. Models with 3000+ Pa handle carpets better.

**Q: How often do I need to empty the dustbin?**
A: Without auto-empty, every 1-2 cycles. With auto-empty, every 4-8 weeks.

**Q: Can robot vacuums clean stairs?**
A: No. Always use physical barriers.

---

## Final Verdict

The **Roborock Qrevo at $279.99** is the best overall. The **Eufy RoboVac X8 at $249.99** offers the best value. And for pet owners, the **Shark IQ Robot at $199.99** is unmatched.
